Method of Attack: Rowhammer technique leveraging GPU via WebGL to trigger bit flips in DRAM
Discoverer: VUSec Lab at Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
Impacted Systems: Android smartphones running Snapdragon 800 and 801 SoCs
Attack Vector: Malicious JavaScript code hosted on a website
Indicators of Compromise: WebGL-based JavaScript code targeting DDR3 and DDR4 memory chips
